reference_kind: Published state statements external to the computed consensus; literature-source overlap with threshold motivation disclosed.
limitations: A small literature sanity check, not an expert gold set or an estimate of population accuracy. The references come from papers also used to motivate indicator thresholds, so threshold-source overlap prevents a fully held-out validation claim.

eldon2019.exclusion: Radiation and heat-flux changes do not specify a timed attached/detached/MARFE state. High radiated fraction or radiative collapse alone is not assigned MARFE.

eldon2022.exclusion: Worked control examples are KSTAR shots, not DIII-D records in this evaluation.

matching: Only the half-open bin [start_ms, start_ms+bin_ms) containing each published instant; no nearest-bin fallback or duration inference.
metrics_policy: Coverage uses every primary point including unavailable shots. F1 treats abstention as a false negative. Kappa is defined only on cast votes and is null for a degenerate one-class table.
